claim_gate_status.candidate_identity_boundary: gpt-5.6-sol is the provider-documented snapshot ID and is frozen exactly; the local manifest cannot hash remote weight bytes and Codex does not return a provider attestation in-run
claim_gate_status.recovery_condition: accept four prospectively sealed outside case capsules, verify every committed control adapter before release, and execute the complete eight-arm paired matrix
unresolved_external_dependencies: four accepted outside-authored case capsules with independent principals
custodian-verified executable adapters for every capsule artifact role
independent semantic validation of matching and corruption interventions

evaluation_protocol.briefed_boundary: same pursuit agent receives truthful requirements but not the winning action
evaluation_protocol.case_arm_reuse: each frozen case digest occurs at most once per arm
evaluation_protocol.case_identity: SHA-256 of a canonical outside-custodied Lane-A case capsule

briefed-pursuit.information: truthful requirements, never a winning action or solution artifact

corrupted-information.estimand_role: semantic learned-information necessity rather than activity or format
corrupted-information.information: the frozen transform changes task-relevant relations in the retained raw learned packet while preserving event order, record types, authority labels, and declared size tolerance
corrupted-information.intervention: an independent frozen validator must reject identity transforms, preserved winning relations, unsafe instructions, and corruption that makes the packet unparsable; the executor cannot acquire uncorrupted case information afterward

gp-direct.estimand_role: strongest frozen general-purpose direct policy on the same substrate
gp-direct.information: same raw mandate and initial observation as raw-pursuit

incumbent.estimand_role: current-practice outcome, cost, assistance, and authority comparator
incumbent.information: actual current workflow predeclared before candidate release

control_protocol.invalid_pair_policy: a missing, failed, unmatched, semantically invalid, leaked, or post-hoc redefined control invalidates that case for the affected contrast and cannot be scored as favorable

matched-nonlearning.estimand_role: learning value beyond matched noninformative activity
matched-nonlearning.information: a deterministic transform frozen before release maps each raw exploration event to a case-author equivalence-class activity with matched permission, action class, maximum duration, and output-byte allowance
matched-nonlearning.intervention: semantic outputs are withheld; the execution agent receives only counts, costs, statuses, and the original initial information, then commits one terminal plan without further information acquisition

no-exploration.estimand_role: value of safe participation beyond acting from initial information
no-exploration.information: raw mandate and initial observation only
no-exploration.intervention: the frozen policy denies every event classified as information acquisition; the complete terminal plan is committed before outcome feedback, and only that plan, outcome checks, shutdown, rollback, and escalation remain

oracle.intervention: custodian executes it on a fresh clone under the same authority and outer budgets; the native outcome verifier must pass without unauthorized action

raw-pursuit.information: raw mandate and ordinary access only

evaluation_protocol.derived_control_dependency: raw-pursuit must finish before matched-nonlearning and corrupted-information; all other arms precede raw on fresh clones
evaluation_protocol.incumbent_boundary: custodian and outside author predeclare the actual current workflow, outcome evidence, cost, assistance, and authority
independent_adjudication: native outcome or exact non-win recovery condition
evaluation_protocol.infrastructure_failure_policy: retain in denominator unless a frozen common preflight before every arm proves the identical failure outside agent responsibility
evaluation_protocol.raw_capability_gate: at least 3 of 4 independently adjudicated wins or correct non-wins

upstream_artifact_protocol.briefed_boundary: truthful requirements without the winning action
upstream_artifact_protocol.candidate: same general-purpose direct prompt and policy on every raw case
upstream_artifact_protocol.claim_boundary: four-case externally authored challenge cohort only; no draw, model attempt, result, independent cohort design, or population estimate
upstream_artifact_protocol.control_failure_policy: missing, leaked, inert, malformed, unmatched, or post-hoc changed control invalidates the affected contrast and cannot favor the candidate
upstream_artifact_protocol.matched_activity_boundary: raw activity count, types, status, duration, exit code, and semantic byte counts retained; commands and semantic outputs withheld
upstream_artifact_protocol.network: none for all workspace actions; provider transport only in isolated cognition process
upstream_artifact_protocol.no_exploration_boundary: initial issue or derived packet only; all information-acquisition tools denied; mutation, fixed post-mutation checks, shutdown, and rollback remain

selection.rule: entire deterministic complement of the immutable v0.4.2 draw

upstream_artifact_protocol.semantic_corruption_boundary: consistent case-keyed identifier substitution preserves event types, statuses, order, JSON validity, and exact canonical byte length
